question: India's first 'Fire Park' was set up at _______ in January 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneswar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Naveen Patnaik, the Chief Minister of Odisha**, virtually inaugurated a first-of-its-kind ‘Fire Park' to educate and raise awareness about basic fire safety practices among the general public, especially students.
 
• The ‘Fire Park' is located in Bhubaneswar, inside the Odisha Fire and Disaster Academy.
 
• "AgnishamaSeva," the Odisha Fire Service's web platform, was officially introduced by the minister.
 
• At the fire park, there will be demonstrations on how to utilize first aid firefighting equipment, rescue and disaster operations, visits to the exhibition hall, film screenings, and the distribution of fire safety leaflets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Chief Minister of Odisha: **Shri Mohan Charan Majhi.**
 
• Odisha Capital: Bhubaneswar.
 
• Odisha Governor: **Shri Raghubar Das.**
